brief:
Settlers attacked participants at an olive-picking event in Wadi al-Sha'ir in Salfit, the Ma'an news agency reported. The assault occurred during the community gathering aimed at harvesting olives in the area.

Details of injuries or the number of attackers were not immediately available. The incident is the latest in a series of confrontations between Palestinian communities and settlers in the occupied West Bank.
title: Settlers attack Palestinians at olive harvest in Salfit
